completion_rule: overall_status may become LIVE_PROVEN only when every obligation is CLOSED_PROVEN with provider/runtime readback evidence; repository merge or CI success alone is insufficient

evidence_required: organization-member readback shows MFA enabled for every standing human Owner
evidence is dated and identifies the provider/account role without storing credential material
dated isolated restore succeeds without overwriting production
restored application and representative data are validated
measured RTO and RPO are recorded
cleanup or rollback evidence is recorded
each in-scope credential has provider-side rotation evidence
each dependent consumer has successful post-rotation readback
superseded credentials are revoked or proven unusable
no secret values are stored in repository documentation, logs, or learning records

obligations.owner_plane: GitHub, Netlify, Notion, Buffer, Supabase and other active provider access planes
evidence_required: standing human and service identities are inventoried
roles and permissions are reviewed for least privilege
MFA or equivalent strong authentication is evidenced where supported
stale or unnecessary access is removed and provider readback confirms the resulting state

already_proven.note: backup availability proof does not close the isolated restore obligation
